mo_ta_cong_viec:
We're looking for a Technical Project Manager who lives and breathes e-commerce. You'll lead complex Shopify implementations while keeping teams aligned, informed, and moving forward. This isn't a typical PM role. You'll need deep Shopify expertise to speak the language of developers and the communication chops to translate technical complexity into business value. If you've led Shopify projects from discovery to launch and know how to keep stakeholders engaged across time zones, this could be your next move.
Apply today and be eligible for a one-month sign-on bonus.*
*Terms & Conditions apply.
 
Lead end-to-end project delivery for Shopify-based e-commerce solutions, managing timelines, scope, and quality
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (development, design, QA) to keep projects on track and on budget
Translate technical details into clear, actionable updates for non-technical stakeholders
Drive continuous improvement in processes, tools, and team collaboration
Manage project priorities and mitigate risks proactively
yeu_cau:
3+ years of hands-on project management or technical team leadership experience
Strong Shopify knowledge — whether from a PM, development, or team lead background
Proven e-commerce expertise (retail, consumer goods, or related industries)
Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal) — you can present to executives and troubleshoot with developers
Comfort managing projects remotely and across multiple time zones
